openRight.description: Removes the right border for seamless grouping with adjacent buttons. Use when this button is not the last in a horizontal group.

openLeft.description: Removes the left border for seamless grouping with adjacent buttons. Use when this button is not the first in a horizontal group.

cornerLeft.description: Applies rounded corners to the left side of the button. Use for the first button in a group or when aligning to a container's left edge.

cornerRight.description: Applies rounded corners to the right side of the button. Use for the last button in a group or when aligning to a container's right edge.

icon.description: Applies icon-specific styling for icon-only buttons. When true, supply an icon in the default slot.

disabled.description: Disables the button, preventing user interaction and applying a muted style.

indent.description: Applies an indented background style for emphasis or grouping. Useful for visually separating the button from others or indicating a secondary action.

label.description: The text in the default slot; empty puts none. Main content slot for icon or text label.

iconName.description: The icon in the default slot, by name (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles); empty puts none. Main content slot for icon or text label.

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
